findings.summary: The -pnp test case can't fail: base already prints plain output, so the assertion documents intent rather than guarding the fix
Last-one-wins still stops at the argument boundary (standalone -b then -p), a pre-existing gap the reviewer says is not this PR's job
The scan reads values of short options like -lbash as flags, a pre-existing issue rposition doesn't change

why: Noise set: the reviewer reports no blocking issues and says it would merge; its one nit and two pre-existing items are things a maintainer would merge without.
